decisions.reason: The air quality sensor module has its own page, and with demand still uncertain, keeping it in a modular catalog costs little, so the option stays open.
The voltage measurement module is a new hardware generation that replaces the 2.0 version, so it carries the established demand of its predecessor and is unlikely to be withdrawn soon.
The MQTT software proxy costs almost nothing to keep available and widens connectivity for the whole platform, so keeping it is cheap and valuable.
The CAN bus module is only mentioned on the website and its prospects are still unclear, but carrying it in the catalog costs little and gives it time to show its value for automation customers.
The CO2 sensor module has its own page and serves the growing interest in indoor climate measurement, so the option is worth keeping open.
The touch panel accessory has its own page and low holding costs, so it is kept while its demand becomes clearer.
